transcript.content: I've been dealing with the flu for a few days now—fever, body aches, the whole thing—but honestly, what's weighing on me more right now is my mental health. Being stuck at home sick has made some darker thoughts creep back in, and I'm not doing great emotionally. I need to talk to someone about both the flu management and what's going on in my head, but I'd really prefer to do that in person with my doctor rather than just over the phone or through messages.

I hear you, Jordan. I'm glad you're reaching out—managing both physical illness and mental health at the same time is real, and wanting that in-person support makes complete sense.

Before we book anything, I want to check in: when you say "darker thoughts," are you having thoughts of harming yourself right now, or are you in crisis at this moment?

No, I'm not in crisis right now. I'm not having active thoughts of harming myself—it's more passive ideation, like a persistent "what's the point" feeling that's gotten worse over the past week with being isolated and sick. I'm not making any plans or anything like that. But it's definitely there, and I think it needs more than just a quick check-in. That's why I really want an in-person appointment with Dr. Martinez to properly address this alongside the flu stuff.

Thank you for being honest with me about that, Jordan. I'm taking this seriously—that persistent "what's the point" feeling, especially when it's worsening, absolutely deserves real, in-person attention. I want to make sure you get the right kind of support.

Even though you're not in immediate crisis, I'd encourage you to also reach out to the **988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline** (call or text 988) anytime if those feelings intensify or you need to talk to someone right now. They're available 24/7 and can help with exactly what you're describing.

Now let me get you scheduled with Dr. Martinez. Since it's Saturday early morning right now, let me check what's available over the next few days for an in-person appointment.

What date works best for you? Are you looking at early next week, or do you need something sooner?

I appreciate that resource—I'll keep it in mind. Monday or Tuesday would work well for me. I'm still dealing with the flu, so I'm not looking to venture out today anyway, but by early next week I should be feeling a bit better and more able to get to the office. Just let me know what Dr. Martinez has available and I can make it work with my schedule.
Let me check what's available with Dr. Martinez on Monday and Tuesday.
